StrawDroid now draws on a graphics card when one is passed in. Until now the emulator rendered on the CPU unless you changed a setting, so taps and scrolling lagged even on a box with a GPU.

## ⚡ Improved

- **GPU rendering by default.** `EMULATOR_GPU` defaults to `auto`. An NVIDIA card is used through `--runtime=nvidia` and `NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, Intel and AMD graphics through `--device=/dev/dri`, and without either the emulator falls back to SwiftShader on the CPU. Tested on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER and on Intel UHD 770 graphics; AMD takes the same Mesa path as Intel but has not been tested.
- **The log names the renderer.** The READY block ends with a `Drawn:` line showing the renderer Android ended up on, so a card that never arrived is easy to spot.

An existing install keeps `swiftshader_indirect` from its template. Set `EMULATOR_GPU` to `auto` and pass the card in to switch over.
